I attached a short "regional-demo-checklist.pdf" with what we'll cover and which slides Marcus should prep. I also exported a small .ics with the three options so you can drop into the team's calendars (attached: proposed-time-options.ics).

If any of these look close, pick one and we'll firm up. If you prefer, we can run a 40-minute focused run for the EU decision team and record a separate technical deep-dive for Marcus to share with the SF/Sydney engineers asynchronously.
